blockingRisks.evidence: Six non-patient identifier fields were suggested as patient_id; accepting the defaults created 2792 apparent patients from a 25-patient pilot.
The current canonical schema cannot join labevents.itemid to d_labitems.label; 22 of 25 pilot cases retained numeric lab item codes instead of human-readable analyte names.
Representative short and standard longitudinal prompts were 82407 and 119104 characters before a model call.
The source is 5.868 GiB and the platform requires 12.91 GiB free at job creation; 9.90 GiB was free on C: during validation.
The Admin ingestion endpoint accepts ZIP bundles; the supplied source is a directory of CSV.GZ files.

conclusion: The corrected 25-patient pilot completes preprocessing and isolated SQLite import, but the unmodified full directory is not yet safe or operationally ready for one-click ingestion.
